Name: Childe Tartaglia (Project Genshin Farmer Preset) - Fashion Sense (FS) and Farmer Portraits (FP)
Author: Arknir27
Description:
[size=3]Play as the Eleventh Fatui Harbinger from Genshin Impact. This is the prelude to my upcoming Project Genshin Overhaul. Requires [b]aedenthorn's[/b] framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] and [b]PeacefulEnd's[/b] framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. Special thanks to these amazing mod authors![/size]


[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/1040132886105432114/Right.gif[/img]         [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/1040132885333692428/down.gif[/img]         ﻿ [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/1040132885732130866/Left.gif[/img]         ﻿ [img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/1040132916170203156/up.gif[/img][/center]


[size=3]Includes two portraits of the Farmer/Tartaglia with configurable expressions: the optional smiling portrait and default neutral expression.[/size]

[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/1040134864470556702/the_real_one.png[/img][/center]
[color=#444444].
.[/color]
[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/994361829675507732/Fashion_Sense.png[/img][/center]
[color=#444444].[/color]
[size=3]Dress up in the unique Eleventh Harbinger attire using the Hand Mirror.
Also includes hairstyle, animated scarf/cloak accessory, and shirt. 
Pants not included. You will need to dye your own pants. Light grey pants are recommended.
[/size]

[b][size=4]Hand Mirror Tutorial:[/size][/b]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/1040135235330920499/HandMirror_Tutorial.gif[/img]
* Includes hairstyle, accessory, and shirt
* Pants not included. You will need to dye your own pants. Light grey pants are recommended.


[b][size=4]How to enable the Farmer: Childe/Tartaglia Portraits in-game:[/size][/b]

[size=3]Using the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3], enable all the checkboxes in the image below under the "[/size][b]Farmer Portraits[/b][size=3]" mod.
Make sure to not have any other Farmer portrait mods installed (example: Aether farmer portrait) 
Only one farmer portrait mod should be installed at a time.
[/size]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/842533649337286677/994356640776196116/Configs.png[/img]
[size=2]*Also keep in mind that you may need to lower the zoom level of the UI interface in the settings in-game for portraits to show properly.[/size]

[size=3][b]Special Thanks[/b] to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2893756]YriKururu[/url] for additional help with portraits.[/size]

[size=3]Want to track my progress on Project Genshin Overhaul? You can check my Project Genshin Showcase on my [url=https://ko-fi.com/album/New-Album-V7V0CWKOA]Ko-fi here[/url]﻿. I am also active in the East Scarp discord.
[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Requires latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher. Make sure to have PeacefulEnd's Fashion Sense and aedenthorn's Farmer Portraits installed first.


- Download this mod & unzip all attachments into Stardew Valley/Mods


- Run the game using SMAPI
